args.title: Summary: Tamarack Components — Warehouse Automation in 2026 (+ companion)
args.body:
- Tamarack's newsletter article "Warehouse automation in 2026" reports pick rates rose 18% with autonomous carts, but integration took twice as long as planned.
- The companion piece (insights.tamarack.example, subscriber charts) finds the biggest cost saving came from fewer mis-picks rather than raw speed gains.
- Combined takeaway: automation ROI is driven mainly by accuracy/error reduction, while project timelines should budget roughly 2x the planned integration period.
